Joby Aviation completed its first fully autonomous cross-country flight, covering 3,199 miles without pilot intervention, which marks a significant milestone for eVTOL technology [Joby Aviation flew 3,199 miles](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNdzMyZDlTX2h6OVlwb3FmZV9FaU10TVJhclVOSFU0ZFN3VzljYjRhZ0Q0bWFwd1FRSlh0TUNGb2psckdic0FrcVJUTFZtMk9uM1BqbzdTNXZkOXJiRUhOSDdNcGQ0MW1YRXVWeEpSbFhoODFwVFUxZzV2ZWx2X2t6SQ?oc=5). In other air mobility developments, Beta Technologies launched operations under the federal eVTOL Integration Pilot Program in North Carolina, and Archer Aviation identified initial air taxi routes in Doha.

Federal agencies are expanding oversight and infrastructure for autonomous systems. The US Coast Guard formed a new program office to oversee robotics and autonomous systems [Coast Guard forms new program office](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxNc29vMUs2dkxQMnJNN3lESXVnZlVXYnpYMGNTUmxDUlJfMU8xZjg5WWlNYVJPRGNOR2dLSUdvaGprVVZxdjJCSUh1WU1xMmZ6UEtKd2dGbzlfYzE4U1hFaUhfbWl6aDZfamJTVzJaZkRyWmNyQ3hjZnNSZ2oxRlN0b0o0ekxNLVhMaTA2WE1zc3hxN24tZWc?oc=5), while the Federal Communications Commission cleared a nationwide test of cellular networks for drones [FCC clears nationwide test](https://dronedj.com/2026/09/23/fcc-drone-cellular-network-5g/). Additionally, NASA is modernizing commercial airline systems [NASA modernizes commercial airline systems](https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/armd/aosp/nasa-modernizes-commercial-airline-systems/).

The autonomous ground vehicle sector faces increased regulatory and safety scrutiny. Authorities are investigating Comma AI's hands-off driving technology following fatal crashes [Authorities are investigating Comma AI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxQTGlOYzNXWmFqTTctVUxuemUyZXNJU2xMeS1fWkxMVUVteF90OUdwUGFPdkJNcVlfRHlVdTU3dGI1SjlpLWVs3FEYkVZT2JQQk5PQU5sSUVVZGg3RnVKNzNiYUxxRWlhVzZrcmhneG4zRi1sUXp4SFBpY001RXNINkpCTFNJM3JzaUE?oc=5). Reports also indicate Tesla is operating its Robotaxi service in Texas with an expired state license, and Waymo faces public hearings in Minneapolis regarding regulations.

Global transportation investments continue with China testing a supersonic jet to reduce travel time between Beijing and Shanghai by 75% [China to test supersonic jet](https://news.google.?oc=5). These developments, alongside the US Coast Guard's new office and the Department of Defense's planned counter-drone laser shoot-off, show a trend of increasing investment in autonomous and counter-autonomous technologies.
